title: StampReceipt
$comment: AUTHORED object (§5.1): produced by an actor and validated against this schema. STUB. Tracks §5 of WISHMAIL_SPEC_v0_5.md field for field. Not yet registered under HCS-13: spec/pins.json registeredSchemas is null for this object (T-P9-4, T-P9-9). The specification leads, the schema follows, the tests are the court: where a constraint below is not expressible in JSON Schema, the named test is what holds it. NOTE: §14.3 says "the receipt records the rate used and when" for a method priced by reference to another asset, and §5.4 gives StampReceipt no rate field. This schema tracks §5.4. The gap is raised as a decision candidate and is not closed here.

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

tokenId.description: The stamp token, $POSTAGE (§4.1). No other token is postage.

price.description: What was charged. §14.3: exactly what the price message current at the purchase yields (T-P11-4).

holder.description: Account, or public-key alias where the transfer creates the account (§4.6, T-P16-1).
